parameters.help_en: The start time of the backup. The value must be a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 备份开始时间。UNIX时间，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the backup. The value must be a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 备份结束时间。UNIX时间，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

fields.help_en: The name of the Tablestore instance
fields.help_zh: 备份的表格存储实例名称
fields.name: instance_name

fields.help_en: The names of the tables in the Tablestore instance
fields.help_zh: 备份的表格存储数据表名称
fields.name: table_names

parameters.help_en: The Tablestore instances that are backed up
parameters.help_zh: 备份的表格存储实例列表

parameters.help_zh: 本次查询需要返回的最大数量
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The token that is required to obtain the next page of backup snapshots
parameters.help_zh: 获取下一页快照所需的Token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account or across Alibaba Cloud accounts. Valid values:

SELF_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account.
CROSS_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份 
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The UID of the source account used for cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号Uid
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role that is created within the source Alibaba Cloud account and assigned to the current Alibaba Cloud account to authorize the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name
